title: Mumma Sleep Coach — Current Experience
description: An interactive, fixture-only mirror of the current Mumma first-use journey, plan confirmation, daily plan, sleep monitoring, reminders, journal, research, settings, and light or dark appearance.
limitations: Uses deterministic fixture data and does not connect to the Mumma API or AI services
Account setup, sleep coaching, reminders, monitoring, backup, and reset actions are simulated
State lasts only for the current browser session and no family information is stored or transmitted

items.content: Evaluate whether the local-only first-use promise feels clear and reassuring.
Evaluate whether the Coach makes the next step obvious without implying medical advice.
Evaluate whether explicit confirmation makes it unmistakable that the plan has not changed yet.
Evaluate whether the next sleep event and current plan are easy to scan while tired or distracted.
Evaluate whether logging a sleep or wake event is fast and understandable.
Evaluate whether profile, research, and data controls are grouped predictably.
